items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: And Fletcher Henderson, the big band...

ctx.x: Before you go into the Minneapolis dance band time, let me ask you this. This is already 1926 going into 1927. So what kind of music were you listening to at that time? What kind of influences were going on with your musical development? What kind of records and what kind of...?
Louis Armstrong He was hot then, with that Hot Five. And Fletcher Henderson, the big band...
